question: Who is the director of the film 'Laapataa Ladies', which won Best Picture at the 2025 IIFA Awards?
solution:
The Correct answer is __**Kiran Rao**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Kiran Rao** is a renowned Indian filmmaker and producer, known for her unique storytelling and direction.
 
• She is the director of the film **‘Laapataa Ladies’**, which won **Best Picture** at the **2025 IIFA Awards**, showcasing her exceptional talent and creativity.
 
• Her work often highlights **social issues** and explores unconventional themes in Indian cinema.
 
• Kiran Rao has also made a significant impact on the industry through her contributions to independent cinema and her collaborations with other creative minds.
 
• She gained prominence with her directorial debut **‘Dhobi Ghat’**, which was critically acclaimed for its innovative narrative and artistic approach.
 
• She has been associated with projects that emphasize **progressive storytelling** and promote diverse voices in the Indian film industry.
 
• Her work has been instrumental in bringing a fresh perspective to mainstream Bollywood cinema.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Yash Chopra**__

 __
 
• **Yash Chopra** was an iconic Indian filmmaker and producer, known for his romantic and dramatic films.
 
• He is often referred to as the **‘King of Romance’** in Indian cinema for his films like **‘Dil To Pagal Hai’** and **‘Veer-Zaara’**.
 
• He founded the production company **Yash Raj Films**, which is one of the leading film production houses in India.
 
• While he made a significant contribution to Bollywood, Yash Chopra was not involved in the making of ‘Laapataa Ladies.’
 
 
 
• **Farhan Akhtar**__
 __
 
• **Farhan Akhtar** is an Indian actor, director, producer, and singer known for his versatility.
 
• He directed the critically acclaimed films **‘Dil Chahta Hai’** and **‘Lakshya’**, which marked a new era in Bollywood.
 
• While Farhan Akhtar is known for his innovative direction, he was not the director of ‘Laapataa Ladies.’
 
 
 
• **Karan Johar**__
 
 
• **Karan Johar** is a prominent Indian filmmaker and producer known for his glamorous and family-centric films.
 
• He is the director of blockbuster hits like **‘Kabhi Khushi Kabhie Gham’** and **‘Student of the Year.’**
 
• Karan Johar’s style is different from the storytelling approach seen in ‘Laapataa Ladies,’ which was directed by Kiran Rao.
